677:t_008:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's a rare occurrence. I agree with you too.」

677:t_008:20.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I cannot understand your words. But one thing is certain.」

677:t_008:21.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Humanity has no need for emotions.」

677:t_009:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This world has no need for emotions.」

677:t_009:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then there would be no more sorrow or suffering...」

677:t_009:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...I get it. I'll bring this to a close for you.」

677:t_009:6.en:
$$バサラ$$
「It looks like this is the finale!」

677:t_009:9.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Let's show them... no, let them hear our feelings... our songs, $$バサラ$$!」

677:t_009:10.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we goooo!! Listen to my songggg!!」

677:t_010:2.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I can hear $$バサラ$$ singing...」

677:t_010:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Even if we fail, even if we're ready to give up, we keep trying...」

677:t_010:6.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I cannot understand. I ask what purpose this noise serves.」

677:t_010:8.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If you can't understand that, you will never understand humans.」

677:t_010:9.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Someone like you calling yourself God... the ruler of humanity is a complete joke!」

677:t_010:11.en:
$n
「Are you going to announce you'll kill us, like every villain does?」

677:t_010:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「You should learn from $$アル$$ and $$チェインバー#pilot$$, about humans and about what to say at a time like this!」

677:t_010:13.en:
$$アル$$
「Then, $$チェインバー#pilot$$, give that overthinking woman a word of advice.」

677:t_010:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Drop dead, you tin can bastard!」

677:t_011:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's do this, $$チェインバー#pilot$$! I'm human and you're a machine, and together we'll stop her!」

677:t_011:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Humans are not tools. Humans seek better ways to use tools for their own happiness.」

677:t_011:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$. I hope you will learn what humans are through this battle.」

677:t_012:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! Our battle with you ends here too!」

677:t_012:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Come on! We'll take on all your feelings!」

677:t_012:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Even that arrogance... feels pleasant to me now.」

677:t_012:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But I too have pride and stubborn resolve! As my last act, I shall make a barren flower bloom upon this planet!」

677:t_012:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「To all units! Your attack targets are the original $$ストライカー#pilot$$ and $$ミカゲ$$!」

677:t_012:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's go! We'll break through them and take down the $$ギャラクシー船団$$!」

677:t_013:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Now that $$ストライカー#pilot$$ and $$ミカゲ$$ are gone, no one can stop us!」

677:t_013:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「All that's left is to take down the battleship fused with a $$バジュラ$$!」

677:t_013:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, regroup. We're launching an assault!」

677:t_014:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I see movement from the $$バトル・フロンティア$$!」

677:t_014:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is bad...! Has it fully fused with the $$クィーン#vajra$$?!」

677:t_014:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「A new swarm of $$バジュラ$$ and $$ゴースト$$ units are coming!」

677:t_015:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「They still had that much fighting strength left?!」

677:t_015:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「If they gather all the $$バジュラ$$ deployed around this planet, they'll have several times that many!」

677:t_015:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「I have detected a powerful $$フォールドウェーブ$$ from the $$クイーン・フロンティア$$!」

677:t_015:3.en:
$$ルカ$$
「They are probably controlling the $$バジュラ$$ by combining it with control through $$インプラント$$s!」

677:t_015:4.en:
$$カナリア$$
「And now the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ has acquired the power of the $$バジュラ$$ queen.」

677:t_015:5.en:
$$ルカ$$
「The power of that $$フォールドウェーブ$$ must be far beyond any artificial means they've used so far.」

677:t_015:6.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「That is correct. There is nothing you can do now.」

677:t_015:8.en:
$$カトル$$
「It's coming from the $$バトル・フロンティア$$!」

677:t_015:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Is it a man... or a woman...? What the hell was that?!」

677:t_015:10.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Are several people's voices overlapping?!」

677:t_015:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「Their voices aren't the only things overlapping! Their consciousnesses are too!」

677:t_015:12.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「This is the truth for attaining $$シンカ$$ recorded in the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins...」

677:t_015:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Truth... $$シンカ$$...! Is that what Supreme Commander $$不動$$ was talking about?!」

677:t_015:14.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「To that end, we pooled our consciousnesses and attempted to create a single individual.」

677:t_015:15.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Yes, to become the same kind of beings as the super-dimensional life-forms... the $$バジュラ$$, and advance life to its next stage...」

677:t_015:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So this is an attempt to unite humans as one...」

677:t_015:17.en:
$$キリコ$$
「They... are just like $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.」

677:t_015:18.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're going to become the same as the $$バジュラ$$ and use their power?!」

677:t_015:19.en:
$$クレア$$
「They too are possessed by $$シンカ$$...」

677:t_015:20.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Now, $$バジュラ$$! Our will is the queen's will... You cannot refuse it!」

677:t_015:21.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Are you saying even $$バサラ$$'s songs can't compete?!」

677:t_015:23.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Is this really the time to act so relaxed?!」

677:t_015:24.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「You are right! Even your songs might not get through to them!」

677:t_015:25.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I'm not the only one singing!」

677:t_015:26.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, $$バジュラ$$! Listen to our songggg!!」

677:t_016:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's '$$ライオン$$' by the $$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$!」

677:t_016:3.en:
$$ランカ$$
(I'll sing, $$アルト$$, for everyone, for myself, and for the $$バジュラ$$!)

677:t_016:4.en:
$$シェリル$$
(My feelings didn't reach you... But I have my songs...)

677:t_016:5.en:
$$シェリル$$
(I'll set them free now!)
